profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ DataNinja, Inc.
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer with strong experience in front-end development, REST APIs, third-party integrations, and full-stack web application development across manufacturing and insurance industries. Experienced in building scalable systems, improving business workflows and collaborating across teams to deliver reliable software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and shipped front-end features for a MES (Manufacturing Execution System) platform, collaborating with the team to deliver new functionality and improve the overall product experience.

Implemented localization enhancements for the MES platform, adding Spanish language support to improve accessibility and provide Spanish-speaking clients with a more seamless application experience.

Enhanced UI workflows across the MES platform, including sales order inspection, material reservation management, and third-party ZPL integration for managing label templates and printing labels.

Supported ERP integrations, including NetSuite, helping ensure smooth data synchronization between systems. Participated in customer support rotation and provided on-site support during software implementations, working directly with customers to troubleshoot issues and help ensure a successful rollout.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Built and shipped front-end features for an insurance quoting platform, integrating third-party APIs for data intelligence and policy data reconciliation. Modernized public-facing pages and collaborated on internal tools and REST APIs to improve workflows and support business needs.

Enhanced transaction reporting workflows by automating the reporting of business transactions to the appropriate state's surplus lines association, improving efficiency and reducing manual processing.

Contributed to the design and development of a full-stack, standalone document generation system, improving document generation speed, supporting template-based document creation, and providing a scalable foundation for growing business demand.

Contributed to the design and development of a full-stack, standalone rules engine for managing underwriter risk criteria, supporting automated underwriting for applications that met defined criteria.

Mentored front-end engineers, promoting consistency, maintainable code, and shared development practices across the team.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: For this internship I continue learning about the importance of Test Driven Development (TDD) and helping write unit tests.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: For this internship I honed my frontend skills by building web features, adding form validation and consuming REST API endpoints.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Started my professional journey with this internship by helping to write unit tests, research and implement new testing frameworks.

volunteerExperiences.description: My volunteer actions consisted of helping with labeling, measuring and packaging of food.

My volunteer actions consisted of helping with the coordination and operation of the event held at one of the elementary schools in the Salt Lake Area.
The intention of the event was to involve the participants in various soccer related activities and have them meet with some professional players playing for the Real Salt Lake soccer team.

projects.title: Rethinck Cloud Music Player
projects.description:
The "Rethinck" Project was based primarily on using WCF (Windows Communication Foundation) technology for communicating to various devices through different software platforms (e.g. mobile, web, desktop). Offers the end-user the convenience of uploading music from either the desktop or web versions of our application and have music streaming from the cloud directly to any of the platforms available: mobile, desktop or web.

Responsibilities:

•	Designed the front end GUI for the mobile application
•	Helped with integrating music player functionality (e.g. play, skip, volume, display playlists, etc.)
•	Added user authentication for the mobile platform
•	Integrated an achievements system making use of the IActionable API found at:  http://iactionable.com/

projects.title: Grade My <T> website
projects.description:
"Grade My <T>" is built using ASP.NET MVC 2 technology. It is a highly user-driven website where all users are encouraged to give constant feedback of what is of public interest for the majority. It offers users a new and easy way to rate any topic they want such as movies, books, pets, electronic devices, etc. In addition, they can keep track of the most popular topics thanks to our rating system. 

Responsibilities:

•	Participated in writing front end project documentation and requirements
•	Helped with the implementation of a database storage system
•	Prototyped and designed the front end GUI of the website
•	Integrated a rating system
